title: Post-hoc Epistemic Uncertainty for Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.29730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies need to recognize gaps in their training knowledge to request useful demonstrations or assistance in new situations, especially when failures are costly. Disagreement within an ensemble of independently trained policies can guide these decisions, but requires training and running multiple policies. We propose post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from the embeddings of a single policy. Each head computes the conditional variance of a Gaussian process conditioned on embeddings from the training demonstrations. Fitting requires no regression targets or gradient updates and leaves the policy unchanged. In experiments with SmolVLA on LIBERO-10, the kernel variance heads perform competitively with two-policy ensemble scores in task-level correlation with task success, in demonstration acquisition during active learning, and in referral to a stronger supervisor policy as a pr

translated_title: 视觉-语言-动作策略的后验认知不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略需要识别其训练知识中的空白，以便在新情况下请求有用的示范或协助，尤其是在失败代价高昂的场景中。独立训练的策略集合内部的分歧可以指导这类决策，但这需要训练和运行多个策略。我们提出了后验核方差头，能够从单一策略的嵌入中估计认知不确定性。每个头计算以训练示范的嵌入为条件的高斯过程条件方差。该方法的拟合不需要回归目标或梯度更新，且不改变原有策略。在SmolVLA于LIBERO-10上的实验中，核方差头在与任务成功的任务级相关性、主动学习期间的示范获取、以及向更强监督策略转介等方面，与双策略集成分数相比表现具有竞争力。
tldr: 提出了一种后验核方差头方法，无需训练多个策略或修改原策略，即可从单一VLA策略的嵌入中估计认知不确定性，其表现与双策略集成方法相当。
en_tdlr: Proposes post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from a single VLA policy's embeddings without training ensembles or modifying the policy, achieving performance competitive with two-policy ensembles on LIBERO-10.
